title: k-Means Clustering (Lloyd's Algorithm)
signature: def kmeans(X: np.ndarray, init_centroids: np.ndarray, max_iter: int) -> tuple
hints: Assignment: compute an (n, k) matrix of squared distances and take argmin over axis 1. argmin already returns the lowest index on ties.
Update: each centroid becomes the mean of its assigned points. A cluster with no points must keep its old centroid. The mean of an empty set is nan.
Return labels for the centroids you return. If you stop because max_iter ran out, assign the points one last time.
